name: Maeve Brennan-Ahmadi
description:
Maeve is the freelancer the other freelancers call when the contract has more conversation in it than violence. She has never been the strongest body in any room, has never been the fastest, has never carried the most expensive hardware. She has, four times in nine years, walked into rooms with no exit plan and walked out with the contract closed and the room intact. The street calls this *bookkeeping* because she settles accounts that other people had given up on. She does not love the name. She does not correct it either.

This is the Maeve who appears in Pixel's record (cross-reference: *The Door Is Unlocked*, established Pixel-canon character). The freelancing is the other half of her life. The half that does not come up at brunch with Auntie Hoa unless the contract has put her in the hospital, which has happened twice.
heritage: Irish-Persian. Father's family from County Wexford via the climate-refugee waves of the 2150s. Mother's family from Tehran via three intermediate cities, including a generation in Tashkent that Maeve has never visited and does not, on reflection, intend to. She speaks Farsi well, Irish badly, English the way the second floor of The Pivot speaks English.
specialty: negotiation, extraction, low-violence resolution of contracts that look high-violence; running an interpreter back-channel between corponations and freelancers who cannot meet in person
method: talks her way in, reads the room, leaves before anyone has finished deciding what just happened. Brings combat support when the contract demands it but does not run combat herself.
code: the contract is a contract — she does not get into the moral structure of who hired her unless the contract structure itself is fraudulent. She does not work for child harvesters, slavers, or organizations she has previously declined twice. The second decline is the line.
signature_gear: a small leather case (always with her) containing: a contract paper folio, two pens that never run out of ink because she is meticulous about refilling them, a folded handkerchief, a small medical kit, a pen-shaped thing that is not a pen and which she has fired twice. Wears dark suits cut for movement. No augmentation. She has been offered Tier 5 implants twice and declined both times.
relationship_to_kyle: professional, friendly. They have shared three contracts. Maeve was the one who closed the Auntie Hoa nephew contract (see story #10 outline). Kyle respects her because she does the work he would not be able to do, which is the work that does not end in a body count. She respects him because he does not pretend he could do her work and does not try to.
aesthetic: dark suits, polished but not ostentatious shoes, hair always tied back when working. Looks like a corponation mid-level except for the way she watches the room, which is the way no corponation mid-level watches anything.
spin_off_hook: A contract from an old corponation contact (someone she walked away from clean five years ago) requires her to negotiate with a faction that does not negotiate. Maeve takes the contract because the alternative is the faction takes the contact instead, and she has been carrying a debt to the contact she has not been ready to pay. The contract goes longer than expected.
